seed.in_sample_note: fit window 2010-2025 contains every evaluation season

seed.meta_region_poolaware: selection referee; the published P(1st) is measured against it
seed.seed / seed_chalk: built from the same head-to-head table
seed.(all seasons): the 2010-2025 fit window contains every evaluation season

torvik.cand:tv_* / cand:tv_mass80_*: candidate bases are barthag or 80% barthag
torvik.cand:mass_avg_*: the Massey composite includes Torvik as a member system
torvik.blend, pit (referees and strategies): both fitted models take Torvik team stats as features

blend.seed: half of blend's pairwise mass is the seed table

market.(none of the production candidate bases): market is not a candidate base and was never selected against

market_v2.(none of the production candidate bases): same inputs as market with the construction defects fixed; not a candidate base, never selected against

odds_api.(none): direct multi-book closing consensus, 2021-2025 only; referee-only

fte.(none): external ratings; never used anywhere in the pipeline
